resources.string: A limited selection of public product records is stored on this device. Records may be outdated or incomplete. A missing record says nothing about whether a product is vegan.
No match in the limited offline snapshot. Other products may exist in the online database.
Install several regions (up to 10 packs, 10 MB / 10,000 products each). Updating one region keeps your other packs. You can also import a downloaded JSON file.
Could not import or remove this pack. Check its format and size. Your previously installed data has been kept.
Some offline data could not be loaded. Other installed data remains available.
Download selected regions for offline checks and Browse. Download size and SHA-256 are verified before installation. Records remain community-maintained and may be incomplete.
Downloads are paused in offline mode. Installed packs remain available.
The catalog host and download hosts receive your IP address and pack requests. No scans, history, or credentials are sent.
No regional packs listed yet. Refresh the catalog or import a pack from your device.
Regional data could not be downloaded or verified. Check the catalog URL and connection, then retry. Installed packs were kept.
